analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Post-Q2 beat: Bernstein (Mark Newman) raised PT to $350 from $340 (Buy reiterated); Wedbush (Dan Ives) raised PT to $350 from $320 (Outperform). BNP Paribas raised to $300 on Apr 17. Consensus avg ~$301-$312 across 27-28 analysts. Raymond James downgraded to Market Perform in Jan 2026 (isolated). Overall 78% buy consensus.

competitor_activity: All Magnificent Seven companies (Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, Apple) reported strong Q2 earnings this week. Apple differentiated via capital-light AI strategy — CapEx only $4.3B for first half FY2026, vs. massive AI infrastructure spend by Microsoft, Alphabet, and Meta. Samsung remains top smartphone rival but Apple topped Samsung in global shipments for first time in 14 years (FY2025). Some analyst concern Apple AI features lag competitors, but Q2 results validated the leaner approach. Sources: Motley Fool May 1 2026, Yahoo Finance.
